<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Support;

/**
 * Canonical audit-event name catalog for the Events module.
 *
 * Mirrors Epic 1's `RevolutWebhookEventCatalog` and the Streaming
 * module's `StreamingAuditEvents` — surfaces every `event:` string
 * passed to `$auditLogger->log(...)` from an Epic 2 / Epic 3 service so:
 * 1. Renames are tractable via static analysis.
 * 2. New audit emissions consult the catalog rather than invent strings.
 * 3. Downstream analytics / search treats these as a closed vocabulary.
 *
 * Resolves Pass-2 finding S2-1-F7 / S2-2-F11 family (Events slice).
 * Companion catalog for Streaming module is
 * `app/Modules/Streaming/Support/StreamingAuditEvents.php`.
 *
 * Naming convention: `event.<resource>[_<denied>]`. Denied variants emit
 * separately from a separate-tx in the service so a logger throw cannot
 * mask the EventStateLocked / IllegalStateTransition exception.
 */
final class EventAuditEvents
{
    // Story 2-1 — creation
    public const EVENT_CREATED = 'event.created';

    // Story 2-2 — metadata
    public const EVENT_METADATA_UPDATED = 'event.metadata_updated';

    public const EVENT_METADATA_UPDATE_DENIED = 'event.metadata_update_denied';

    // Story 2-3a — state machine
    public const EVENT_TRANSITIONED = 'event.transitioned';

    public const EVENT_TRANSITION_DENIED = 'event.transition_denied';

    // Story 2-5 — cancellation
    public const EVENT_CANCELLED = 'event.cancelled';

    public const EVENT_CANCEL_DENIED = 'event.cancel_denied';

    // Story 2-6 — super-admin moderation
    public const EVENT_SUSPENDED = 'event.suspended';

    public const EVENT_SUSPEND_DENIED = 'event.suspend_denied';

    public const EVENT_REACTIVATED = 'event.reactivated';

    public const EVENT_REACTIVATE_DENIED = 'event.reactivate_denied';

    // Story 2-2 — speakers
    public const EVENT_SPEAKER_ADDED = 'event.speaker_added';

    public const EVENT_SPEAKER_UPDATED = 'event.speaker_updated';

    public const EVENT_SPEAKER_REMOVED = 'event.speaker_removed';

    public const EVENT_SPEAKERS_REORDERED = 'event.speakers_reordered';

    // Story 3-1 / 3-3 — landing + form config
    public const EVENT_LANDING_SETUP_SAVED = 'event.landing_setup_saved';

    public const EVENT_REGISTRATION_FORM_CONFIG_SAVED = 'event.registration_form_config_saved';

    // Story 3-10 — public registration consent audit trail
    public const REGISTRATION_CREATED = 'registration.created';

    public const REGISTRATION_UPDATED = 'registration.updated';

    // Story 12.2 — aggregate existing-contact audience attachment
    public const EVENT_AUDIENCE_CONTACTS_ATTACHED = 'event.audience.contacts_attached';

    private function __construct() {}
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Platform\AuditLogging\Core;

use Platform\AuditLogging\Contracts\AuditLoggerInterface;
use Platform\AuditLogging\Contracts\AuditStorageInterface;
use Platform\AuditLogging\Contracts\AuditSubjectInterface;
use Platform\AuditLogging\Contracts\AuditableInterface;

/**
 * Default audit logger: enriches entry via AuditManager, dispatches to storage.
 */
class AuditLogger implements AuditLoggerInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditStorageInterface $storage,
        private readonly AuditManager $manager,
    ) {}

    public function log(
        string $event,
        string $description,
        mixed $subject = null,
        mixed $target = null,
        array $properties = [],
    ): void {

        // Extract subject identity
        $subjectId = null;
        $subjectType = null;
        if ($subject instanceof AuditSubjectInterface) {
            $subjectId = (string) $subject->getAuditIdentifier();
            $subjectType = $subject->getAuditTypeName();
        }

        // Extract target identity
        $targetId = null;
        $targetType = null;
        if ($target instanceof AuditableInterface) {
            $targetId = (string) $target->getAuditableId();
            $targetType = $target->getAuditableType();
        }

        $entry = new AuditEntry(
            event: $event,
            description: $description,
            subjectId: $subjectId,
            subjectType: $subjectType,
            targetId: $targetId,
            targetType: $targetType,
            properties: $properties,
        );

        // Enrich with context (IP, user agent, batch ID, auto-subject)
        $entry = $this->manager->enrich($entry);

        // Dispatch to storage backend — audit logging is best-effort,
        // storage failures must not crash the application
        try {
            $this->storage->store($entry);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            if (function_exists('report')) {
                report($e);
            } else {
                error_log('[AuditLogger] Storage failure: ' . $e->getMessage());
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * @extends Factory<Event>
 */
class EventFactory extends Factory
{
    protected $model = Event::class;

    public function definition(): array
    {
        $startsAt = $this->faker->dateTimeBetween('+1 day', '+60 days');
        $endsAt = (clone $startsAt)->modify('+1 hour');

        return [
            'uuid' => (string) Str::uuid(),
            'team_id' => Team::factory(),
            'state' => EventState::DRAFT->value,
            'title' => $this->faker->sentence(4),
            'description' => $this->faker->paragraph(),
            // Produces a string; Eloquent's EventType cast hydrates it to an enum
            // instance on the model (both make() and create() go through the cast).
            'type' => $this->faker->randomElement(EventType::cases())->value,
            'starts_at' => $startsAt,
            'ends_at' => $endsAt,
            'timezone' => 'UTC',
            'created_by' => User::factory(),
        ];
    }

    public function withLanding(string $template = 'classic'): self
    {
        return $this->afterCreating(function (Event $event) use ($template) {
            if (!$event->landingPage()->exists()) {
                \App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage::forceCreate([
                    'event_id' => $event->id,
                    'team_id' => $event->team_id,
                    'template' => $template,
                    'primary_color' => '#8B2323',
                ]);
            }
        });
    }

    public function inState(EventState $state): self
    {
        return $this->state(fn () => ['state' => $state->value]);
    }

    public function cancelled(): self
    {
        return $this->state(fn () => [
            'cancelled_at' => now(),
            'cancel_reason' => $this->faker->sentence(),
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Scopes;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Scope;
use Platform\Tenancy\Contracts\TenantContextInterface;

class TeamScope implements Scope
{
    /**
     * Apply the scope to a given Eloquent query builder.
     *
     * Uses TenantContextInterface from the platform-tenancy package
     * to resolve the current tenant ID. Fails closed (WHERE 1=0)
     * when no tenant context is available.
     */
    public function apply(Builder $builder, Model $model): void
    {
        $tenantContext = app(TenantContextInterface::class);

        // System admin bypass — skip scoping entirely
        if ($tenantContext->shouldBypassTenantScope()) {
            return;
        }

        $tenantId = $tenantContext->getTenantId();

        if ($tenantId !== null) {
            $builder->where(
                $model->getTable() . '.team_id',
                $tenantId
            );
        } else {
            // Fail closed — no tenant context means no records
            $builder->whereRaw('1=0');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Extend the query builder with macros.
     *
     * @param Builder $builder
     */
    public function extend(Builder $builder): void
    {
        $builder->macro("withoutTeamScope", function (Builder $builder) {
            return $builder->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class);
        });

        $builder->macro("forAllTeams", function (Builder $builder) {
            return $builder->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class);
        });

        $builder->macro("forTeam", function (Builder $builder, $team) {
            $teamId = is_object($team) ? $team->id : $team;
            return $builder
                ->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class)
                ->where("team_id", $teamId);
        });

        $builder->macro("forCurrentTeam", function (Builder $builder) {
            $tenantContext = app(TenantContextInterface::class);
            $tenantId = $tenantContext->getTenantId();

            if ($tenantId !== null) {
                return $builder
                    ->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class)
                    ->where("team_id", $tenantId);
            }
            return $builder->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class)->whereRaw('1=0');
        });

        $builder->macro("forUserTeams", function (
            Builder $builder,
            $user = null,
        ) {
            $user = $user ?: \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth::user();
            if ($user && method_exists($user, 'teams')) {
                $teamIds = $user->teams()->pluck("teams.id");
                return $builder
                    ->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class)
                    ->whereIn("team_id", $teamIds);
            }
            return $builder->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class)->whereRaw('1=0');
        });
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Platform\Authz\Http;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class RouteCapabilityMiddleware
{
    private const REQUEST_EVALUATED_ATTRIBUTE = 'platform_authz.route_capability_evaluated';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly RouteRequirementResolver $resolver,
    ) {}

    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        if ($request->attributes->get(self::REQUEST_EVALUATED_ATTRIBUTE) === true) {
            return $next($request);
        }

        $request->attributes->set(self::REQUEST_EVALUATED_ATTRIBUTE, true);

        $routeName = $request->route()?->getName();

        if (!$routeName) {
            abort(403, 'Route must be named for permission checks.');
        }

        $requirement = $this->resolver->resolve($routeName);

        // A protected named route without an explicit route-permission mapping is a
        // configuration error. Fail closed rather than silently widening access.
        if ($requirement === null) {
            abort(403, 'Route permission mapping is missing for this route.');
        }

        // Public routes bypass all auth/capability checks — the route is
        // open to all visitors, authenticated or not.
        if ($requirement->type === RouteRequirement::TYPE_PUBLIC) {
            return $next($request);
        }

        $user = $request->user();

        if (!$user) {
            abort(403, 'Authentication required.');
        }

        if (!$this->evaluate($requirement, $user)) {
            abort(403, 'You do not have permission to access this route.');
        }

        return $next($request);
    }

    public function evaluate(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        return match ($requirement->type) {
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_PUBLIC => true,
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_NONE => true,
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_SINGLE => $this->evaluateSingle($requirement, $user),
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_ANY_OF => $this->evaluateAnyOf($requirement, $user),
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_ALL_OF => $this->evaluateAllOf($requirement, $user),
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_SPECIAL => $this->evaluateSpecial($requirement, $user),
            default => false,
        };
    }

    private function evaluateSingle(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        return Gate::forUser($user)->allows($requirement->capabilities[0]);
    }

    private function evaluateAnyOf(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        foreach ($requirement->capabilities as $capability) {
            if (Gate::forUser($user)->allows($capability)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function evaluateAllOf(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        foreach ($requirement->clauses as $clause) {
            if (!$this->evaluate($clause, $user)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private function evaluateSpecial(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        $method = $requirement->specialMethod;
        if ($method === null || !method_exists($user, $method)) {
            return false;
        }
        return (bool) $user->$method();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Platform\AuditLogging\Core;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Platform\AuditLogging\Contracts\AuditStorageInterface;

/**
 * Spatie Activity Log storage adapter.
 *
 * Wraps Spatie's `activity()` helper to persist audit entries.
 * Requires spatie/laravel-activitylog to be installed in the host app.
 */
class SpatieAuditStorage implements AuditStorageInterface
{
    public function store(AuditEntry $entry): void
    {
        $logger = activity($entry->event);

        // Set causer (who performed the action)
        if ($entry->subjectId !== null && $entry->subjectType !== null) {
            // Try to resolve as an Eloquent model for Spatie's causedBy()
            $causerModel = $this->resolveCauserModel($entry->subjectType, $entry->subjectId);
            if ($causerModel) {
                $logger->causedBy($causerModel);
            }
        }

        // Set subject (what was acted upon)
        if ($entry->targetId !== null && $entry->targetType !== null) {
            $targetModel = $this->resolveTargetModel($entry->targetType, $entry->targetId);
            if ($targetModel) {
                $logger->performedOn($targetModel);
            }
        }

        // Add properties including context
        $properties = $entry->properties;

        if ($entry->ip !== null) {
            $properties['ip'] = $entry->ip;
        }

        if ($entry->userAgent !== null) {
            $properties['user_agent'] = $entry->userAgent;
        }

        if ($entry->batchId !== null) {
            $properties['batch_uuid'] = $entry->batchId;
        }

        if (!empty($properties)) {
            $logger->withProperties($properties);
        }

        $logger->log($entry->description);

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Platform\AuditLogging\Contracts\AuditStorageInterface;

/**
 * Spatie Activity Log storage adapter.
 *
 * Wraps Spatie's `activity()` helper to persist audit entries.
 * Requires spatie/laravel-activitylog to be installed in the host app.
 */
class SpatieAuditStorage implements AuditStorageInterface
{
    public function store(AuditEntry $entry): void
    {
        $logger = activity($entry->event);

        // Set causer (who performed the action)
        if ($entry->subjectId !== null && $entry->subjectType !== null) {
            // Try to resolve as an Eloquent model for Spatie's causedBy()
            $causerModel = $this->resolveCauserModel($entry->subjectType, $entry->subjectId);
            if ($causerModel) {
                $logger->causedBy($causerModel);
            }
        }

        // Set subject (what was acted upon)
        if ($entry->targetId !== null && $entry->targetType !== null) {
            $targetModel = $this->resolveTargetModel($entry->targetType, $entry->targetId);
            if ($targetModel) {
                $logger->performedOn($targetModel);
            }
        }

        // Add properties including context
        $properties = $entry->properties;

        if ($entry->ip !== null) {
            $properties['ip'] = $entry->ip;
        }

        if ($entry->userAgent !== null) {
            $properties['user_agent'] = $entry->userAgent;
        }

        if ($entry->batchId !== null) {
            $properties['batch_uuid'] = $entry->batchId;
        }

        if (!empty($properties)) {
            $logger->withProperties($properties);

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\AtddOracle;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventAuditEvents;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

/**
 * Independent behavioural checks for the platform-admin "revert a published
 * event back to draft" capability.
 *
 * Everything here binds only to seams that already exist in the application:
 * the named platform-admin route, the persisted `events.state` column, the
 * `activity_log` audit table written by the guarded transition path, the
 * `EventState` enum's public API, and the route-permission configuration.
 */
class OracleTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    private const ROUTE_NAME = 'admin.events.revert-to-draft';

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC2 — reverting a PUBLISHED event with no registrations
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function platform_admin_reverts_a_published_event_without_registrations_to_draft(): void
    {
        $organiser = $this->workspace();
        $event = $this->publishedEvent($organiser);
        $admin = $this->platformAdmin();

        $this->revertAs($admin, $event);

        $this->assertSame(
            EventState::DRAFT->value,
            $this->persistedState($event),
            'A PUBLISHED event with no registrations must be back in DRAFT after a platform-admin revert.',
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function revert_records_the_lifecycle_transition_through_the_audited_path(): void
    {
        $organiser = $this->workspace();
        $event = $this->publishedEvent($organiser);
        $admin = $this->platformAdmin();

        $this->revertAs($admin, $event);

        $this->assertSame(
            EventState::DRAFT->value,
            $this->persistedState($event),
            'Precondition: the revert must have moved the event to DRAFT.',
        );

        $row = DB::table('activity_log')
            ->where('log_name', EventAuditEvents::EVENT_TRANSITIONED)
            ->where('subject_type', Event::class)
            ->where('subject_id', $event->getKey())
            ->orderByDesc('id')
            ->first();

        $this->assertNotNull(
            $row,
            'The revert must be recorded through the guarded transition path, which writes a lifecycle transition audit row.',
        );

        $this->assertSame(
            (string) $admin->getKey(),
            (string) $row->causer_id,
            'The audit row must attribute the revert to the acting platform admin.',
        );

        $properties = json_decode((string) $row->properties, true);
        $this->assertIsArray($properties, 'The transition audit row must carry its properties payload.');

        $this->assertSame(
            EventState::PUBLISHED->value,
            $properties['from'] ?? null,
            'The transition audit row must record PUBLISHED as the state it moved away from.',
        );
        $this->assertSame(
            EventState::DRAFT->value,
            $properties['to'] ?? null,
            'The transition audit row must record DRAFT as the state it moved into.',
        );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC1 — the route itself
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function revert_route_is_a_post_route_gated_by_the_route_permission_configuration(): void
    {
        $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName(self::ROUTE_NAME);

        $this->assertNotNull($route, 'A named route "'.self::ROUTE_NAME.'" must be registered.');

        $methods = $route->methods();

        $this->assertContains('POST', $methods, 'The revert route must accept POST.');
        $this->assertNotContains(
            'GET',
            $methods,
            'A state-changing revert must not be reachable with a safe GET request.',
        );

        $mappings = (array) config('route_permissions.routes', []);

        $this->assertArrayHasKey(
            self::ROUTE_NAME,
            $mappings,
            'The revert route must be declared in the route-permission configuration.',
        );

        $requirement = $mappings[self::ROUTE_NAME];

        $this->assertIsString(
            $requirement,
            'The revert route must require a capability, not merely authentication.',
        );
        $this->assertNotSame(
            '__public__',
            $requirement,
            'The revert route must not be publicly reachable.',
        );
        $this->assertNotSame(
            '',
            trim($requirement),
            'The revert route must map to a non-empty capability requirement.',
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function revert_is_refused_for_a_workspace_admin_of_the_owning_workspace(): void
    {
        $organiser = $this->workspace();
        $event = $this->publishedEvent($organiser);
        $workspaceAdmin = $this->member($organiser, UserRole::ADMIN);

        $response = $this->revertAs($workspaceAdmin, $event);

        $response->assertForbidden();

        $this->assertSame(
            EventState::PUBLISHED->value,
            $this->persistedState($event),
            'A workspace-level admin must not be able to drive the platform-admin revert action.',
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function revert_is_refused_for_an_unauthenticated_visitor(): void
    {
        $organiser = $this->workspace();
        $event = $this->publishedEvent($organiser);

        $response = $this->post($this->revertUrl($event), ['reason' => 'Published by mistake']);

        $this->assertTrue(
            $response->getStatusCode() >= 300,
            'An unauthenticated revert attempt must not succeed (got HTTP '.$response->getStatusCode().').',
        );

        $this->assertSame(
            EventState::PUBLISHED->value,
            $this->persistedState($event),
            'An unauthenticated revert attempt must leave the event PUBLISHED.',
        );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC3 / AC4 / AC5 — refusals
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function revert_is_refused_for_events_that_are_not_published(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->platformAdmin();

        foreach (EventState::cases() as $state) {
            if ($state === EventState::PUBLISHED) {
                continue;
            }

            $organiser = $this->workspace();
            $event = Event::factory()->for($organiser)->inState($state)->create();

            $this->revertAs($admin, $event);

            $this->assertSame(
                $state->value,
                $this->persistedState($event),
                "An event in state {$state->value} must not be moved by the revert action.",
            );
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function revert_is_refused_when_the_event_already_has_registrations(): void
    {
        $organiser = $this->workspace();
        $event = $this->publishedEvent($organiser);
        $this->registerAttendee($event);
        $admin = $this->platformAdmin();

        $this->revertAs($admin, $event);

        $this->assertSame(
            EventState::PUBLISHED->value,
            $this->persistedState($event),
            'An event that already has registrations must stay PUBLISHED.',
        );

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('activity_log', [
            'log_name' => EventAuditEvents::EVENT_TRANSITIONED,
            'subject_type' => Event::class,
            'subject_id' => $event->getKey(),
        ]);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function cancelled_published_event_cannot_be_reverted(): void
    {
        $organiser = $this->workspace();
        $event = Event::factory()
            ->for($organiser)
            ->inState(EventState::PUBLISHED)
            ->cancelled()
            ->create();
        $admin = $this->platformAdmin();

        $this->revertAs($admin, $event);

        $this->assertSame(
            EventState::PUBLISHED->value,
            $this->persistedState($event),
            'Cancellation must keep winning over lifecycle moves: a cancelled event must not be reverted.',
        );

        $this->assertNotNull(
            DB::table('events')->where('id', $event->getKey())->value('cancelled_at'),
            'The revert attempt must not clear the cancellation flag.',
        );

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('activity_log', [
            'log_name' => EventAuditEvents::EVENT_TRANSITIONED,
            'subject_type' => Event::class,
            'subject_id' => $event->getKey(),
        ]);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC6 — the rest of the state machine is untouched
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function legal_transition_table_gains_only_the_published_to_draft_edge(): void
    {
        $expected = [
            'draft' => ['published', 'suspended', 'failed'],
            'published' => ['preparing', 'suspended', 'failed', 'draft'],
            'preparing' => ['ready', 'failed', 'suspended'],
            'ready' => ['live', 'failed', 'suspended'],
            'live' => ['ended', 'failed', 'suspended', 'ready'],
            'ended' => ['failed', 'suspended'],
            'failed' => ['preparing', 'suspended'],
            'suspended' => [],
        ];

        foreach (EventState::cases() as $from) {
            foreach (EventState::cases() as $to) {
                $legal = in_array($to->value, $expected[$from->value], true);

                $this->assertSame(
                    $legal,
                    $from->canTransitionTo($to),
                    "Edge {$from->value} -> {$to->value} must be ".($legal ? 'legal' : 'illegal').'.',
                );
            }
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function state_derived_rules_keep_their_existing_answers(): void
    {
        // [metadata locked, blocks registration, live operable, ended,
        //  publicly hidden, indexable when live, registrant viewer mode,
        //  public shell when live, suspendable from]
        $expected = [
            'draft' => [true === false, true, false, false, true, false, null, 'landing', true],
            'published' => [true, false, false, false, false, true, 'registered', 'landing', true],
            'preparing' => [true, false, false, false, false, true, 'registered', 'landing', true],
            'ready' => [true, false, true, false, false, true, 'registered', 'landing', true],
            'live' => [true, false, true, false, false, true, 'live', 'landing', true],
            'ended' => [true, true, false, true, false, true, 'ended', 'landing', true],
            'failed' => [true, true, false, false, true, false, null, 'landing', true],
            'suspended' => [true, true, false, false, false, false, null, 'suspended', false],
        ];

        foreach (EventState::cases() as $state) {
            [
                $metadataLocked,
                $blocksRegistration,
                $liveOperable,
                $ended,
                $publiclyHidden,
                $indexable,
                $viewerMode,
                $shell,
                $suspendable,
            ] = $expected[$state->value];

            $this->assertSame($metadataLocked, $state->isMetadataLocked(), "{$state->value}: metadata lock changed.");
            $this->assertSame($blocksRegistration, $state->blocksRegistration(), "{$state->value}: registration blocking changed.");
            $this->assertSame($liveOperable, $state->isLiveOperable(), "{$state->value}: live-operability changed.");
            $this->assertSame($ended, $state->isEnded(), "{$state->value}: terminal-ended answer changed.");
            $this->assertSame($publiclyHidden, $state->isPubliclyHidden(), "{$state->value}: public hiding changed.");
            $this->assertSame($indexable, $state->isPubliclyIndexable(false), "{$state->value}: public indexability changed.");
            $this->assertSame($viewerMode, $state->registrantViewerMode(), "{$state->value}: registrant viewer mode changed.");
            $this->assertSame($shell, $state->publicShell(false), "{$state->value}: public shell changed.");
            $this->assertSame($suspendable, $state->canBeSuspendedFrom(), "{$state->value}: suspendability changed.");

            $this->assertFalse(
                $state->isPubliclyIndexable(true),
                "{$state->value}: a cancelled event must never be publicly indexable.",
            );
            $this->assertSame(
                'cancelled',
                $state->publicShell(true),
                "{$state->value}: a cancelled event must render the cancelled shell.",
            );
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Fixtures
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    private function workspace(): Team
    {
        $owner = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);

        /** @var Team $team */
        $team = Team::factory()->create(['user_id' => $owner->getKey()]);
        $team->users()->attach($owner, ['role' => UserRole::ADMIN->value]);
        $owner->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->getKey()])->save();

        return $team->fresh();
    }

    /**
     * A platform administrator whose own workspace is deliberately NOT the
     * workspace that owns the event under test — that is the real support
     * scenario this capability exists for.
     */
    private function platformAdmin(): User
    {
        $home = $this->workspace();

        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'current_team_id' => $home->getKey(),
        ]);
        $home->users()->attach($user, ['role' => UserRole::SYSTEM_ADMIN->value]);

        return $user->fresh(['currentTeam']);
    }

    private function member(Team $team, UserRole $role): User
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'current_team_id' => $team->getKey(),
        ]);
        $team->users()->attach($user, ['role' => $role->value]);

        return $user->fresh(['currentTeam']);
    }

    private function publishedEvent(Team $team): Event
    {
        return Event::factory()
            ->for($team)
            ->inState(EventState::PUBLISHED)
            ->withLanding()
            ->create();
    }

    private function registerAttendee(Event $event): void
    {
        $email = 'registrant-'.Str::uuid()->toString().'@example.com';

        DB::table('registrations')->insert([
            'uuid' => (string) Str::uuid(),
            'team_id' => $event->team_id,
            'event_id' => $event->getKey(),
            'email' => $email,
            'email_hash' => hash('sha256', $email),
            'full_name' => 'Registered Attendee',
            'created_at' => now(),
            'updated_at' => now(),
        ]);
    }

    private function revertUrl(Event $event): string
    {
        return route(self::ROUTE_NAME, $event->uuid);
    }

    private function revertAs(User $actor, Event $event): TestResponse
    {
        return $this->actingAs($actor)->post($this->revertUrl($event), [
            'reason' => 'Published by mistake',
        ]);
    }

    private function persistedState(Event $event): string
    {
        return (string) DB::table('events')->where('id', $event->getKey())->value('state');
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Enums;

/**
 * Story 2-1 — Canonical event state machine (Phase 1, 8 states, 20 legal edges).
 *
 * Single source of truth: docs/specs/event-states.md (PF-1 Reading A,
 * reconciled 2026-04-25).
 *
 * - DB column: VARCHAR — values match the lowercase string values below.
 * - SUSPENDED is reachable from any non-SUSPENDED state via EventService::suspend().
 * - Reactivation from SUSPENDED uses the audit ledger (see Story 2-6 sketch).
 */
enum EventState: string
{
    case DRAFT = 'draft';
    case PUBLISHED = 'published';
    case PREPARING = 'preparing';
    case READY = 'ready';
    case LIVE = 'live';
    case ENDED = 'ended';
    case FAILED = 'failed';
    case SUSPENDED = 'suspended';

    /**
     * Canonical legal-transition table. Mirrors docs/specs/event-states.md.
     *
     * @return list<self>
     */
    public function transitionsTo(): array
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::DRAFT => [self::PUBLISHED, self::SUSPENDED, self::FAILED],
            self::PUBLISHED => [self::PREPARING, self::SUSPENDED, self::FAILED],
            self::PREPARING => [self::READY, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::READY => [self::LIVE, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::LIVE => [self::ENDED, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED, self::READY],
            self::ENDED => [self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::FAILED => [self::PREPARING, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::SUSPENDED => [],
        };
    }

    public function canTransitionTo(self $next): bool
    {
        return in_array($next, $this->transitionsTo(), strict: true);
    }

    /** SUSPENDED is reachable from any non-SUSPENDED state. */
    public function canBeSuspendedFrom(): bool
    {
        return $this !== self::SUSPENDED;
    }

    /** True when the event row's core metadata is read-only. */
    public function isMetadataLocked(): bool
    {
        return $this !== self::DRAFT;
    }

    /**
     * True when the event must reject new registrations.
     * DRAFT blocks because the landing page is private until PUBLISHED.
     */
    public function blocksRegistration(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this, [self::DRAFT, self::ENDED, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED], strict: true);
    }

    /**
     * Story 5-14 — True when the event is in a state that supports live
     * streaming operations (control room, go-live, end-event).
     *
     * Single source of truth for the READY|LIVE check previously duplicated
     * across EventActionAvailability, ControlRoomController::isOperable,
     * and StreamingLifecycleService claim methods.
     */
    public function isLiveOperable(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::READY || $this === self::LIVE;
    }

    /**
     * Story 5-14 — True when the event has reached the terminal ENDED state.
     */
    public function isEnded(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::ENDED;
    }

    /** Translation key for UI label. Resolves through __() at render-time. */
    public function label(): string
    {
        return __('events.state.' . $this->value);
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    public static function values(): array
    {
        return array_map(static fn (self $s) => $s->value, self::cases());
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Story 3-17 — Public visibility helpers
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Is the event completely hidden from public visitors?
     * DRAFT and FAILED events are never publicly addressable, regardless of
     * cancellation state. Cancelled-DRAFT is covered by DRAFT.
     */
    public function isPubliclyHidden(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this, [self::DRAFT, self::FAILED], strict: true);
    }

    /**
     * Which public page shell should render?
     *
     * S3-4-F3 — This is a two-level dispatch: shellFor() selects the public page
     * mode (landing/cancelled/suspended), then the Blade second-level dispatch
     * selects the viewer sub-shell via registrantViewerMode().
     *
     * @param bool $cancelled Whether cancelled_at is set on the event row
     */
    public function publicShell(bool $cancelled): string
    {
        if ($cancelled) {
            return 'cancelled';
        }

        return match ($this) {
            self::SUSPENDED => 'suspended',
            default => 'landing',
        };
    }

    /**
     * Which viewer sub-shell should render when a registrant is authenticated?
     * Returns null for states where registrant viewer access is not applicable.
     *
     * @return ?string 'registered' | 'live' | 'ended' | null
     */
    public function registrantViewerMode(): ?string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::PUBLISHED,
            self::PREPARING,
            self::READY => 'registered',
            self::LIVE => 'live',
            self::ENDED => 'ended',
            default => null,
        };
    }

    /**
     * Is this event eligible for public indexing (sitemap, registrant access links)?
     *
     * @param bool $cancelled Whether cancelled_at is set on the event row
     */
    public function isPubliclyIndexable(bool $cancelled): bool
    {
        if ($cancelled) {
            return false;
        }

        return in_array($this, [
            self::PUBLISHED,
            self::PREPARING,
            self::READY,
            self::LIVE,
            self::ENDED,
        ], strict: true);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Services;

use App\Authz\EntitlementChecker;
use App\Enums\PlatformKillSwitchKey;
use App\Exceptions\PlatformKillSwitchActiveException;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\AiAudit\Enums\AiAuditOrganizerStatus;
use App\Modules\AiAudit\Services\AiAuditRequestService;
use App\Modules\Events\Contracts\Repositories\EventRepositoryInterface;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventOperationalLockKey;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Events\EventCancelled;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\EventOperationalLockActive;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\EventStateLocked;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\IllegalStateTransition;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\PlanGateFailed;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\PublishPrerequisiteMissing;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventAuditEvents;
use App\Scopes\TeamScope;
use App\Services\PlatformKillSwitchService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event as EventDispatcher;
use Platform\AuditLogging\Contracts\AuditLoggerInterface;

/**
 * Epic 2 refactor — lifecycle cluster extracted from EventService (publish + cancel).
 *
 * Move-only: all bodies are byte-for-byte from EventService.
 * Mechanical rewrites:
 *   - $this->transition(...) → $this->stateMachine->transition(...) in publish() (1 site)
 *   - $this->authorizeEventPublish(...) → $this->authorizeEventPublish(...) (stays private here)
 *   - $this->authorizeEventCancel(...) → $this->authorizeEventCancel(...) (stays private here)
 *   - $this->entitlements → $this->entitlements (promoted to constructor param)
 * Error-log tag updated: '[EventService]' → '[EventLifecycleService]'.
 */
class EventLifecycleService
{
    public const PUBLISH_REASON_PLAN_GATE = 'plan_gate';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditLoggerInterface $auditLogger,
        private readonly EntitlementChecker $entitlements,
        private readonly EventRepositoryInterface $events,
        private readonly EventStateMachineService $stateMachine,
        private readonly EventAuthorizationService $authz,
        private readonly AiAuditRequestService $aiAuditRequests,
        private readonly PlatformKillSwitchService $killSwitches,
        private readonly EventOperationalLockService $operationalLocks,
    ) {}

    public function publish(Event $event, User $actor): Event
    {
        // R1 BLOCKER #1 (2-3b) — service-layer Gate.
        // events.publish.team is Admin-only (per AC5: Co-host CANNOT publish).
        // This MUST run before the entitlement check so a Co-host on a Pro
        // plan does not fall through into transition() via events.update.team.
        // Entitlement/plan-gate check is NOT here — it stays in publish() after this call.
        $this->authz->authorizePublish($event, $actor);

        $this->assertMutablePublishPrerequisites($event, $actor);

        if ($event->state === EventState::PUBLISHED) {
            return $this->stateMachine->transition($event, EventState::PUBLISHED, $actor, 'admin.publish');
        }

        // Phase 1: the explicit organizer command may create/reuse and
        // synchronously triage the current snapshot. Provider I/O happens
        // before any event transaction or event-row lock.
        $decision = $this->aiAuditRequests->ensureCurrentPublishDecisionOrRequest($event);

        if (! $decision->isApproved()) {
            throw PublishPrerequisiteMissing::aiAudit($event, $decision->status);
        }

        // Provider latency creates a new authorization boundary. Reload the
        // actor/team context and invalidate its supported permission cache
        // before re-running the publish capability guard. Authorization must
        // remain outside every transaction and row lock.
        $freshActor = User::query()
            ->with('currentTeam')
            ->findOrFail($actor->getKey());
        $freshActor->clearAllPermissionCache();
        $this->authz->authorizePublish($event, $freshActor);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Services;

{

        private readonly EventAuthorizationService $authz,
        private readonly EventReadService $reader,
        private readonly EventStateMachineService $stateMachine,
        private readonly EventModerationService $moderation,
        private readonly EventLifecycleService $lifecycle,
        private readonly EventMetadataService $metadata,
        private readonly EventLandingService $landing,
        private readonly PublicRegistrationService $publicRegistration,
        private readonly PublicLandingService $publicLanding,
    ) {}

    public function getById(int $id): Event
    {
        return $this->reader->getById($id);
    }

    /** @param array{search?: string|null, date_from?: string|null, date_to?: string|null} $filters */
    public function getPaginatedByTab(string $tab, int $perPage = 25, array $filters = []): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        return $this->reader->getPaginatedByTab($tab, $perPage, $filters);
    }

    /** @return Collection<int, Event> */
    public function getDashboardEventsForTeam(Team $team, int $limit = 5): Collection
    {

    }

    public function countEventsForTeam(Team $team): int
    {
        return $this->reader->countEventsForTeam($team);
    }

    public function countUpcomingEventsForTeam(Team $team): int
    {
        return $this->reader->countUpcomingEventsForTeam($team);
    }

    /**
     * Delegates to EventAuthorizationService::authorizeView.
     * Kept as a public method so EventController::show() and the edit flow
     * can call it without knowing the authz service directly.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeViewAccess(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * List-access guard: actor may list events in their current team.
     *
     * Delegates to EventAuthorizationService::authorizeViewAny, which preserves
     * the current EventPolicy::viewAny behavior (events.view.global or events.view.team).
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeListAccess(User $actor): void
    {
        $team = $actor->currentTeam;

        if ($team === null) {
            throw new AuthorizationException('A team context is required to list events.');
        }

        $this->authz->authorizeViewAny($team, $actor);

     */
    public function resolveAndAuthorizeForDeliveryLogs(string $uuid, User $actor): Event
    {
        $event = Event::withoutGlobalScope(\App\Scopes\TeamScope::class)
            ->where('uuid', $uuid)
            ->firstOrFail();

        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);

    }

    /** @return array{visible: bool, can_suspend: bool, can_reactivate: bool, can_force_end: bool} */
    public function moderationActions(Event $event, User $actor): array
    {
        return $this->moderation->moderationActions($event, $actor);
    }

    public function cancel(Event $event, User $actor, string $reason): Event
    {
        return $this->lifecycle->cancel($event, $actor, $reason);
    }

    public function transition(Event $event, EventState $next, User $actor, string $reason = ''): Event
    {
        return $this->stateMachine->transition($event, $next, $actor, $reason);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $changes */
    public function updateMetadata(Event $event, User $actor, array $changes): Event
    {
        return $this->metadata->updateMetadata($event, $actor, $changes);
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers;

use App\Exceptions\PlatformKillSwitchActiveException;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\AiAudit\Enums\AiAuditOrganizerStatus;
use App\Modules\Billing\Exceptions\EventCreditExhaustedException;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventOperationalLockKey;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\EventDomainException;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\EventOperationalLockActive;

use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\PlanGateFailed;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\PublishPrerequisiteMissing;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Requests\StoreEventRequest;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Requests\UpdateEventRequest;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\AudienceBoostCampaignReportService;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventOperationalLockService;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventReportDashboardService;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventService;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventSourceBreakdownReportService;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventActionAvailability;
use App\Modules\Streaming\Enums\ReplayPipelineErrorCode;
use App\Modules\Streaming\Services\ReplayRecordingDownloadService;
use App\Modules\Streaming\Services\StreamingAssetOperationsService;
use DateTimeImmutable;
use DateTimeZone;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Routing\Controller;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;

/**
 * Story 2-1 — thin controller. Validation lives in StoreEventRequest;
 * capability + persistence + audit live in EventService::createDraft.
 */
class EventController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EventService $eventService,
        private readonly EventActionAvailability $eventActionAvailability,
        private readonly EventSourceBreakdownReportService $sourceBreakdownReport,
        private readonly EventReportDashboardService $reportDashboard,
        private readonly AudienceBoostCampaignReportService $audienceBoostCampaignReport,
        private readonly EventOperationalLockService $operationalLocks,
        private readonly StreamingAssetOperationsService $streamingAssetOperations,
        private readonly ReplayRecordingDownloadService $recordingDownloads,
    ) {}

    public function create(): View
    {
        if (! authUser()?->currentTeam) {
            abort(403, __('events.errors.no_active_workspace'));
        }

        return view('events::events.create', [
            'breadcrumbs' => [
                ['label' => __('events.list.title'), 'route' => 'events.index'],
                ['label' => __('events.create.title'), 'route' => null],
            ],
            // Defaults: tomorrow at the current top-of-hour for start, +1 hour for end.
            'defaultStartsAt' => ($startsAt = now()->addDay()->startOfHour())->format('Y-m-d\TH:i'),
            'defaultEndsAt' => $startsAt->copy()->addHour()->format('Y-m-d\TH:i'),
            'defaultTimezone' => old('timezone', config('app.timezone', 'UTC')),
            'timezones' => $this->timezoneOptions(),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(StoreEventRequest $request): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = authUser();

        $team = $user->currentTeam;
        if (! $team) {
            abort(403, __('events.errors.no_active_workspace'));
        }

        try {
            $event = $this->eventService->createDraft(
                team: $team,
                actor: $user,
                metadata: $request->eventMetadata(),
            );
        } catch (EventCreditExhaustedException $exception) {
            if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
                return redirect()
                    ->route('events.create')
                    ->withErrors(['create' => $exception->getMessage()])
                    ->withInput()
                    ->with('reference', $exception->errorCode());
            }

            return response()->json([
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $exception->errorCode(),
                    'message' => $exception->getMessage(),
                ],
            ], $exception->httpStatus());
        }

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->route('events.show', $event)
                ->with('status', __('events.create.success'));
        }

        return response()->json([
            'data' => [
                'uuid' => $event->uuid,
                'state' => $event->state->value,
                'title' => $event->title,
                'starts_at' => $event->starts_at?->toIso8601String(),
                'ends_at' => $event->ends_at?->toIso8601String(),
                'timezone' => $event->timezone,
            ],
        ], 201);
    }

    /**
     * S2-2-F1 — render the edit form for a DRAFT event. Non-DRAFT events
     * are blocked at the service layer (EventStateLocked, 409); we also
     * pre-empt them at the controller for a clearer UX, redirecting back
     * to events.show with a flash explaining the lock.
     */
    public function edit(Request $request, Event $event): View|RedirectResponse
    {
        $adminContext = $this->isAdminEventRoute($request);

        try {
            $this->eventService->authorizeEditFormAccess($event, authUser());
        } catch (EventStateLocked) {
            return redirect()
                ->route($this->eventRouteName($request, 'show'), $event)
                ->with('status', __('events.edit.unavailable_outside_draft'));
        }

        return view('events::events.edit', [
            'breadcrumbs' => [
                ['label' => __('events.list.title'), 'route' => $this->eventRouteName($request, 'index')],
                ['label' => $event->title, 'route' => $this->eventRouteName($request, 'show'), 'parameters' => ['event' => $event->uuid]],
                ['label' => __('events.edit.title'), 'route' => null],
            ],
            'adminContext' => $adminContext,
            'event' => $event,
            'startsAt' => $event->starts_at?->format('Y-m-d\TH:i'),
            'endsAt' => $event->ends_at?->format('Y-m-d\TH:i'),
            'timezones' => $this->timezoneOptions(),
            'eventActions' => $this->eventActionAvailability->for(authUser(), $event),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * S2-2-F1 — apply a metadata update. EventMetadataService refuses
     * non-DRAFT writes (EventStateLocked, 409) and silently drops keys
     * outside the allowed list, so the controller is thin: validate +
     * delegate + branch HTML/JSON.
     */
    public function update(UpdateEventRequest $request, Event $event): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = authUser();

        try {
            $updated = $this->eventService->updateMetadata($event, $user, $request->eventMetadata());
        } catch (EventStateLocked $e) {
            if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
                return redirect()
                    ->route($this->eventRouteName($request, 'show'), $event)
                    ->withErrors(['update' => __('events.errors.state_locked')])
                    ->with('reference', $e->errorCode());
            }

            return response()->json([
                'error' => ['code' => $e->errorCode(), 'message' => __('events.errors.state_locked')],
            ], $e->httpStatus());
        }

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->route($this->eventRouteName($request, 'show'), $updated)
                ->with('status', __('events.edit.success'));
        }

        return response()->json([
            'data' => [
                'uuid' => $updated->uuid,
                'state' => $updated->state->value,
                'title' => $updated->title,
                'description' => $updated->description,
                'starts_at' => $updated->starts_at?->toIso8601String(),
                'ends_at' => $updated->ends_at?->toIso8601String(),
                'timezone' => $updated->timezone,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function publish(Request $request, Event $event): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        try {
            $result = $this->eventService->publish($event, authUser());
        } catch (PlatformKillSwitchActiveException $e) {
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.publish.unavailable.platform_disabled'),
                    'switch' => $e->key->value,
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.publish.unavailable.platform_disabled'));
        } catch (EventOperationalLockActive $e) {
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.publish.unavailable.operations_locked'),
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.publish.unavailable.operations_locked'));
        } catch (PlanGateFailed $e) {
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.prepare.errors.plan_gate'),
                    'entitlement' => $e->entitlement,
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.prepare.errors.plan_gate'));
        } catch (EventStateLocked $e) {
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.errors.state_locked'),
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.errors.state_locked'));
        } catch (PublishPrerequisiteMissing $e) {
            $message = $e->auditStatus instanceof AiAuditOrganizerStatus
                ? __("events.publish.audit_status.{$e->auditStatus->value}")
                : __('events.publish.unavailable.landing_required');

            $audit = $e->auditStatus instanceof AiAuditOrganizerStatus
                ? ['status' => $e->auditStatus->value]
                : null;

            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => $message,
                    'prerequisite' => $e->prerequisite,
                    ...($audit === null ? [] : ['audit' => $audit]),
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), $message);
        } catch (IllegalStateTransition $e) {
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.errors.illegal_transition'),
                    'from' => $e->from->value,
                    'to' => $e->to->value,
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.errors.illegal_transition', [
                'from' => $e->from->label(),
                'to' => $e->to->label(),
            ]));
        } catch (AuthorizationException) {
            // @codeCoverageIgnore
            // TeamScope makes this branch unreachable via HTTP (route model binding
            // returns 404 for foreign events before the controller fires). Retained

            // AuthorizationException path in EventService::authorizeEventPublish()

            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => 'JKM-EVT-1010',
                    'message' => __('events.errors.unauthorized'),
                ],
            ], 403, __('events.errors.unauthorized'));
        }

        $payload = [
            'data' => [
                'uuid' => $result->uuid,
                'state' => $result->state->value,
            ],
        ];

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->route($this->eventRouteName($request, 'show'), $result)
                ->with('status', __('events.publish.success'));
        }

        return response()->json($payload, 200);
    }

    /**
     * Story 2-5 — Cancel an event. Route was missing from routes.php; registered in Story 2-4 R1.
     * Thin controller: validation + service delegation.
     */
    public function cancel(Request $request, Event $event): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate(['reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:500']]);

        try {
            $result = $this->eventService->cancel($event, authUser(), $request->string('reason')->toString());
        } catch (EventStateLocked $e) {
            return $this->cancelErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => ['code' => $e->errorCode(), 'message' => __('events.errors.state_locked')],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.errors.state_locked'));
        } catch (IllegalStateTransition $e) {
            return $this->cancelErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.errors.illegal_transition'),
                    'from' => $e->from->value,
                    'to' => $e->to->value,
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.errors.illegal_transition', [
                'from' => $e->from->label(),
                'to' => $e->to->label(),
            ]));
        } catch (AuthorizationException) {
            return $this->cancelErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => ['code' => 'JKM-EVT-1010', 'message' => __('events.errors.unauthorized')],
            ], 403, __('events.errors.unauthorized'));
        }

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->with('status', __('events.list.messages.cancelled'));
        }

        return response()->json([
            'data' => ['uuid' => $result->uuid, 'state' => $result->state->value],
        ]);
    }

    public function suspend(Request $request, Event $event): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate(['reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:500']]);

        }

                ->back()
                ->with('status', __('events.show.moderation.messages.suspended'));
        }

        return response()->json([
            'data' => ['uuid' => $result->uuid, 'state' => $result->state->value],
        ]);
    }

    public function reactivate(Request $request, Event $event): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate(['reason' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:500']]);

        try {
            $result = $this->eventService->reactivate(
                event: $event,

                reason: $request->string('reason')->toString(),
            );
        } catch (EventDomainException $e) {
            return $this->domainErrorResponse($request, $e, 'moderation');
        }

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()

                ->with('status', __('events.show.moderation.messages.reactivated'));
        }

        return response()->json([

        ]);
    }

    public function forceEnd(Request $request, Event $event): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        try {
            $result = $this->eventService->forceEnd($event, authUser());
        } catch (EventDomainException $e) {
            return $this->domainErrorResponse($request, $e, 'moderation');

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {

                ->back()
                ->with('status', __('events.show.moderation.messages.force_ended'));
        }

        return response()->json([
            'data' => ['uuid' => $result->uuid, 'state' => $result->state->value],
        ]);
    }

    public function lockPublishing(Request $request, Event $event): RedirectResponse
    {
        $payload = $request->validate(['reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:500']]);

        Gate::authorize('events.suspend.global');

        $this->operationalLocks->lock(
            event: $event,
            key: EventOperationalLockKey::PUBLISH,
            actor: authUser(),
            reason: (string) $payload['reason'],
        );

        return redirect()
            ->back()
            ->with('status', __('events.show.operations.messages.publish_locked'));
    }

    public function unlockPublishing(Request $request, Event $event): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize('events.suspend.global');

        $this->operationalLocks->unlock(
            event: $event,
            key: EventOperationalLockKey::PUBLISH,
            actor: authUser(),
            reason: $request->string('reason')->toString(),
        );

        return redirect()
            ->back()
            ->with('status', __('events.show.operations.messages.publish_unlocked'));
    }

    public function lockGoLive(Request $request, Event $event): RedirectResponse
    {
        $payload = $request->validate(['reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:500']]);

        Gate::authorize('events.force_end.global');

        $this->operationalLocks->lock(
            event: $event,
            key: EventOperationalLockKey::GO_LIVE,
            actor: authUser(),
            reason: (string) $payload['reason'],
        );

        return redirect()
            ->back()
            ->with('status', __('events.show.operations.messages.go_live_locked'));
    }

    public function unlockGoLive(Request $request, Event $event): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize('events.force_end.global');

        $this->operationalLocks->unlock(
            event: $event,
            key: EventOperationalLockKey::GO_LIVE,
            actor: authUser(),
            reason: $request->string('reason')->toString(),
        );

        return redirect()
            ->back()
            ->with('status', __('events.show.operations.messages.go_live_unlocked'));

    {
        Gate::authorize('events.force_end.global');

        $result = $this->streamingAssetOperations->retryReplay($event, authUser());

        return redirect()
            ->back()
            ->with('status', __("events.show.streaming_assets.retry_results.{$result}"));
    }

    public function retryReplayStage(
        Request $request,
        Event $event,
        string $stage,
    ): RedirectResponse {
        Gate::authorize('events.force_end.global');
        $actor = authUser();
        abort_unless($actor instanceof User, 403);

        $result = $this->streamingAssetOperations->retryStage(
            $event,
            $stage,
            $actor,
        );

        if ($result === 'ineligible') {
            $error = ReplayPipelineErrorCode::INVALID_STAGE_RETRY;

            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->withErrors([
                    'replay_stage' => $error->value.': '.__($error->messageKey()),
                ]);
        }

        return redirect()
            ->back()
            ->with('status', __("events.show.streaming_assets.retry_results.{$result}"));
    }

        ]);
    }

    /** Keep bookmarked Prepare URLs working while the workflow lives in Control Room. */
    public function prepareRedirect(Event $event): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->eventService->authorizeViewAccess($event, authUser());

        return redirect()->route('events.control-room', ['eventUuid' => $event->uuid]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
     */
    private function publishErrorResponse(Request $request, array $payload, int $status, string $message): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            $auditStatus = data_get($payload, 'error.audit.status');

            if (is_string($auditStatus)) {
                return redirect()
                    ->back()
                    ->with('publish_audit_status', $auditStatus);
            }

            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->withErrors(['publish' => $message]);
        }

        return response()->json($payload, $status);
    }

    private function isAdminEventRoute(Request $request): bool
    {
        return $request->routeIs('admin.events.*');
    }

    private function eventRouteName(Request $request, string $suffix): string
    {
        return ($this->isAdminEventRoute($request) ? 'admin.events.' : 'events.').$suffix;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
     */
    private function cancelErrorResponse(Request $request, array $payload, int $status, string $message): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->withErrors(['cancel' => $message]);
        }

        return response()->json($payload, $status);
    }

    private function domainErrorResponse(Request $request, EventDomainException $e, string $errorBag): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->withErrors([$errorBag => __('events.errors.domain_error')])
                ->with('reference', $e->errorCode());
        }

        return response()->json([
            'error' => [
                'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                'message' => __('events.errors.domain_error'),
            ],
        ], $e->httpStatus());
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{id: string, name: string, offset: int}>
     */
    private function timezoneOptions(): array
    {
        $now = new DateTimeImmutable('now');
        $options = array_map(static function (string $timezone) use ($now): array {
            $offset = (new DateTimeZone($timezone))->getOffset($now);

            return [
                'id' => $timezone,
                'name' => sprintf('%s %s', self::formatOffset($offset), $timezone),
                'offset' => $offset,
            ];
        }, DateTimeZone::listIdentifiers(DateTimeZone::ALL));

        usort($options, static function (array $left, array $right): int {
            if ($left['id'] === 'UTC') {
                return -1;
            }

            if ($right['id'] === 'UTC') {
                return 1;
            }

            return [abs($left['offset']), -$left['offset'], $left['id']]
                <=> [abs($right['offset']), -$right['offset'], $right['id']];
        });

        return $options;
    }

    private static function formatOffset(int $offset): string
    {
        $sign = $offset >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
        $absolute = abs($offset);
        $hours = intdiv($absolute, 3600);
        $minutes = intdiv($absolute % 3600, 60);

        return sprintf('UTC%s%02d:%02d', $sign, $hours, $minutes);
    }
}

use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\TestDox;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

/**
 * Platform-admin revert of a published event back to draft.
 *
 * Support occasionally needs to pull a webinar back to DRAFT when an organiser
 * published it by mistake and nobody has registered yet.
 */
#[Group('events')]
class AdminRevertToDraftTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('AC1 — a named POST route exists under the platform-admin event routes and is capability gated')]
    public function revert_route_is_registered_and_capability_gated(): void
    {
        $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName('admin.events.revert-to-draft');

        $this->assertNotNull($route);
        $this->assertContains('POST', $route->methods());
        $this->assertArrayHasKey(
            'admin.events.revert-to-draft',
            (array) config('route_permissions.routes'),
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('AC2 — a PUBLISHED event with no registrations is moved back to DRAFT')]
    public function platform_admin_reverts_published_event_to_draft(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->workspace();
        $event = $this->event($workspace, EventState::PUBLISHED);

        $this->actingAs($this->platformAdmin($workspace))
            ->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid));

        $this->assertSame(EventState::DRAFT->value, $this->stateOf($event));
    }

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('AC3 — an event that is not PUBLISHED is refused and keeps its state')]
    public function revert_is_refused_when_event_is_not_published(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->workspace();
        $event = $this->event($workspace, EventState::LIVE);

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->platformAdmin($workspace))
            ->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid));

        $response->assertRedirect();
        $this->assertSame(EventState::LIVE->value, $this->stateOf($event));
    }

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('AC4 — an event that already has registrations is refused and keeps its state')]
    public function revert_is_refused_when_event_has_registrations(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->workspace();
        $event = $this->event($workspace, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        $this->addRegistration($event);

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->platformAdmin($workspace))
            ->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid));

        $response->assertRedirect();
        $this->assertSame(EventState::PUBLISHED->value, $this->stateOf($event));
    }

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('AC5 — a cancelled event cannot be reverted')]
    public function cancelled_event_cannot_be_reverted(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->workspace();
        $event = Event::factory()
            ->for($workspace)
            ->inState(EventState::PUBLISHED)
            ->cancelled()
            ->create();

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->platformAdmin($workspace))
            ->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid));

        $response->assertRedirect();
        $this->assertSame(EventState::PUBLISHED->value, $this->stateOf($event));
    }

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('AC1 — an unauthenticated visitor cannot revert an event')]
    public function unauthenticated_visitor_cannot_revert(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->workspace();
        $event = $this->event($workspace, EventState::PUBLISHED);

        $this->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid));

        $this->assertSame(EventState::PUBLISHED->value, $this->stateOf($event));
    }

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('AC6 — the PUBLISHED → DRAFT edge is the only lifecycle edge this story adds')]
    public function published_to_draft_is_the_only_new_edge(): void
    {
        $this->assertTrue(EventState::PUBLISHED->canTransitionTo(EventState::DRAFT));
        $this->assertFalse(EventState::LIVE->canTransitionTo(EventState::DRAFT));
        $this->assertFalse(EventState::ENDED->canTransitionTo(EventState::DRAFT));
    }

    private function workspace(): Team
    {
        $owner = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);
        $team = Team::factory()->create(['user_id' => $owner->getKey()]);
        $team->users()->attach($owner, ['role' => UserRole::ADMIN->value]);
        $owner->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->getKey()])->save();

        return $team->fresh();
    }

    private function platformAdmin(Team $team): User
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'current_team_id' => $team->getKey(),
        ]);
        $team->users()->attach($user, ['role' => UserRole::SYSTEM_ADMIN->value]);

        return $user->fresh(['currentTeam']);
    }

    private function event(Team $team, EventState $state): Event
    {
        return Event::factory()->for($team)->inState($state)->create();
    }

    private function addRegistration(Event $event): void
    {
        $email = 'attendee-'.Str::uuid()->toString().'@example.com';

        DB::table('registrations')->insert([
            'uuid' => (string) Str::uuid(),
            'team_id' => $event->team_id,
            'event_id' => $event->getKey(),
            'email' => $email,
            'email_hash' => hash('sha256', $email),
            'full_name' => 'Attendee',
            'created_at' => now(),
            'updated_at' => now(),
        ]);
    }

    private function stateOf(Event $event): string
    {
        return (string) DB::table('events')->where('id', $event->getKey())->value('state');
    }
}
